metadata.name: GH Release
metadata.description: Github Action for creating Github Releases
metadata.author: softprops

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: Note-worthy description of changes in release

inputs.name: body_path
inputs.description: Path to load note-worthy description of changes in release from

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Gives the release a custom name. Defaults to tag name

inputs.name: tag_name
inputs.description: Gives a tag name. Defaults to github.ref_name. refs/tags/<name> values are normalized to <name>.

inputs.name: draft
inputs.description: Keeps the release as a draft. Defaults to false. When reusing an existing draft release, set this to true to keep it draft; omit it to publish after upload. On immutable-release repositories, use this for prereleases that upload assets and publish the draft later.

inputs.name: prerelease
inputs.description: Identify the release as a prerelease. Defaults to false

inputs.name: preserve_order
inputs.description: Upload artifacts sequentially in the provided order. This does not control the final display order GitHub uses for release assets.

inputs.name: files
inputs.description: Newline-delimited list of path globs for asset files to upload. Escape glob metacharacters when matching literal filenames that contain them. `~/...` expands to the runner home directory. On Windows, both \ and / path separators are accepted. GitHub may normalize raw asset filenames that contain special characters; the action restores the asset label when possible, but the final download name remains GitHub-controlled.

inputs.name: working_directory
inputs.description: Base directory to resolve 'files' globs against. Defaults to the workspace root used by the action step.

inputs.name: overwrite_files
inputs.description: Overwrite existing files with the same name. Defaults to true

inputs.name: fail_on_unmatched_files
inputs.description: Fails if any of the `files` globs match nothing. Defaults to false

inputs.name: repository
inputs.description: Repository to make releases against, in <owner>/<repo> format

inputs.name: token
inputs.description: Authorized GitHub token or PAT. Defaults to github.token when omitted. A non-empty explicit token overrides GITHUB_TOKEN. Passing an empty string treats the token as unset.

inputs.name: target_commitish
inputs.description: Commitish value that determines where the Git tag is created from. Can be any branch or commit SHA. When creating a new tag for an older commit, `github.token` may not have permission to create the ref; use a PAT or another token with sufficient contents permissions if you hit 403 `Resource not accessible by integration`.

inputs.name: discussion_category_name
inputs.description: If specified, a discussion of the specified category is created and linked to the release. The value must be a category that already exists in the repository. If there is already a discussion linked to the release, this parameter is ignored.

inputs.name: generate_release_notes
inputs.description: Whether to automatically generate the name and body for this release. If name is specified, the specified name will be used; otherwise, a name will be automatically generated. If body is specified, the body will be pre-pended to the automatically generated notes.

inputs.name: previous_tag
inputs.description: Optional. When generate_release_notes is enabled, use this tag as GitHub's previous_tag_name comparison base. If omitted, GitHub chooses the comparison base automatically.

inputs.name: append_body
inputs.description: Append to existing body instead of overwriting it. Default is false.

inputs.name: make_latest
inputs.description: Specifies whether this release should be set as the latest release for the repository. Drafts and prereleases cannot be set as latest. Can be `true`, `false`, or `legacy`. Uses GitHub api default if not provided

outputs.name: url
outputs.description: URL to the Release HTML Page

outputs.name: upload_url
outputs.description: URL for uploading assets to the release

outputs.name: assets
outputs.description: JSON array containing information about each uploaded asset, in the format given [here](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/reference/repos#upload-a-release-asset--code-samples) (minus the `uploader` field)

diagnostics.message: unknown key `env` in the action's metadata is ignored
